gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: An empty filter vacuously contains itself because there are no bits set that could be absent from itself.
ADDED i2: Use a large shape (3157 hash functions, 3157 bits) to exercise the filter structure
ADDED i3: An empty Bloom filter must contain itself: vacuous containment holds because every bit set in the contained filter (none) is also set in the container.
ADDED i4: SimpleBloomFilter has no special characteristics (not SPARSE, not SPARSE|UNIQUE, etc.)
